title: Lior and the Machine
author: Jude Iversen
blurb: Jonah Sandoval, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
